title: Bug: interactive prompt input line flickers in agent mode (CLI 0.42.0, linux)

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly describes a bug where the interactive prompt input line flickers and undergoes rapid redraw while typing in agent mode on CLI 0.42.0 (Linux), providing expected vs actual behavior and full environment context.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Fixing terminal redraw flickering during typing in agent mode involves React/Ink UI state management, optimizing re-render boundaries, and ensuring layout stability across InputPrompt and Composer components.

summary.problem: The interactive prompt input line flickers and rapidly redraws while typing in agent mode.
summary.root_cause: Unnecessary re-renders or layout recalculations in InputPrompt and Composer triggered on input buffer updates during keypress events in agent mode.
summary.context: Reported on CLI version 0.42.0 on Linux when typing in interactive prompt mode.

steps: Audit keystroke handling and state updates in InputPrompt and Composer during active agent mode.
Memoize render outputs and state derivations triggered on text buffer input to prevent redundant component updates on every keypress.
Ensure layout dimensions for the input container remain stable during typing.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The input prompt input line renders smoothly and stably without flickering during user typing in agent mode.
verification_steps: Simulate sequential keypresses in agent mode within InputPrompt.test.tsx.
Verify that render frame counts remain optimal and no layout or flickering regression occurs.
